ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the front door.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在前门旁。

ex.en: Placing bicycle racks at the front of public buildings can encourage more residents to cycle.
ex.zh: 在公共建筑前部设置自行车架，可以鼓励更多居民骑车出行。

col: at the front of｜在……的前部
tip: in front of指外部前方；at the front of指前部。

ex.en: Daily practice helped me play the guitar more confidently.
ex.zh: 每天练习让我弹吉他时更加自信。

ex.en: Schools should give students opportunities to put scientific knowledge into practice through experiments and practical projects.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生有机会通过实验和实践项目，将科学知识付诸应用。

tip: 英式名词用practice，动词用practise；美式均用practice。

ex.en: This backpack is better than my old one.
ex.zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。

ex.en: Better public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
ex.zh: 更好的公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，并改善发展中城市的就业可达性。

tip: 是good和well的比较级，不说more better。

senses.en: to stop trying to do something

ex.en: The math problem is hard, but I will never give up.
ex.zh: 这道数学题很难，但我永远不会放弃。

ex.en: Our teacher tells us not to give up when we meet difficulties in science class.
ex.zh: 老师告诉我们在科学课上遇到困难时不要放弃。

col: give up a bad habit｜改掉坏习惯
tip: give up后接名词或动词ing形式，常用于鼓励自己或他人别放弃。

senses.en: a small white or colored stick used for writing on a blackboard

ex.en: Please pass me a piece of white chalk from the desk.
ex.zh: 请从桌子上递给我一支白色粉笔。

ex.en: Our art teacher uses colorful chalk to draw bright flowers on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 我们的美术老师用彩色粉笔在黑板上画明亮的花朵。

col: a piece of chalk｜一支粉笔
tip: chalk是不可数名词，表示“一支粉笔”要说a piece of chalk。

senses.en: a person who tells or writes interesting stories

ex.en: My grandpa is a wonderful storyteller in our big family.
ex.zh: 我爷爷是我们大家庭里一位很棒的讲故事的人。

ex.en: In Chinese culture, a skilled storyteller can make old folk tales come alive.
ex.zh: 在中国文化中，技艺高超的讲故事的人能让古老的民间故事变得生动。

col: a great storyteller｜很棒的讲故事的人
listen to a storyteller｜听讲故事的人讲故事
tip: 合成词由story（故事）和teller（讲述者）组成，注意中间双写l。

ex.en: We talked about our future while walking home.
ex.zh: 我们走路回家时聊了聊我们的未来。

ex.en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to protect the environment for future generations worldwide.
ex.zh: 各国政府应投资可再生能源，为世界各地的子孙后代保护环境。

tip: in the future指将来；英式in future常指从今以后。

senses.en: to work as hard as I possibly can to do something

ex.en: I will try my best to win the running race tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天会尽我最大的努力去赢得跑步比赛。

ex.en: Every time we have a school project, I try my best to finish it well.
ex.zh: 每次学校有项目作业时，我都会尽我最大的努力把它做好。

col: try my best to do｜尽我最大努力去做
always try my best｜总是尽全力
try one's best｜尽某人最大的努力
tip: 使用时可根据主语把my换成his、her或our，后常接to do。

senses.en: used to praise someone for doing something very well

ex.en: You finished all your math homework cleanly today, so well done!
ex.zh: 你今天把数学作业都工整地做完了，做得真好！

ex.en: When our class won the singing contest, our music teacher smiled and said well done!
ex.zh: 当班里赢得歌唱比赛时，我们的音乐老师微笑着说“做得好”！

tip: 用于表扬别人某件事完成得很出色，常独立成句，相当于“干得好”。

w: a key to a new world

senses.zh: 一把通往新世界的钥匙
senses.en: something important that helps open up new knowledge or experiences

ex.en: Reading good books is a key to a new world for children.
ex.zh: 对孩子们来说，读好书是一把通往新世界的钥匙。

ex.en: Learning English well gives students a key to a new world of science and culture.
ex.zh: 学好英语能给学生们提供一把通往科学与文化新世界的钥匙。

col: a key to knowledge｜通往知识的钥匙
open a new world｜打开新世界
the key to success｜成功的关键
tip: 表示“……的钥匙”时，key后面搭配介词to，而不是of。

ex.en: The scientist examined a drop of water under the microscope.
ex.zh: 这位科学家用显微镜观察了一滴水。

ex.en: Scientists are developing more efficient batteries to support the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研发效率更高的电池，以支持从化石燃料向可再生能源的转型。

tip: scientist指人，science指科学，scientific是形容词。

ex.en: This robot can recognise a familiar human voice.
ex.zh: 这个机器人能识别熟悉的人声。

ex.en: Human activity has significantly altered natural habitats, making wildlife conservation an urgent priority for governments.
ex.zh: 人类活动已显著改变自然栖息地，使野生动物保护成为各国政府迫切需要优先处理的事项。

tip: human是“人类的”；humane是“人道的”。

ex.en: We spent the afternoon exploring narrow streets near the harbour.
ex.zh: 我们花了一下午探访港口附近的狭窄街巷。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to explore different career options before choosing subjects for further study.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生在选择深造科目前探索不同的职业方向。

tip: 作及物动词时直接接地点或问题，不加about。

senses.en: the area far beyond the Earth where stars and planets exist

ex.en: Astronauts travel into outer space in a fast rocket.
ex.zh: 宇航员乘坐快速的火箭前往太空。

ex.en: Many young students dream of exploring outer space and learning more about distant planets.
ex.zh: 许多小学生梦想着探索太空，去了解更多关于遥远行星的知识。

col: travel into outer space｜进入太空旅行
life in outer space｜太空中的生命
tip: outer意为“外部的”，space作“太空”讲时通常不加the。

ex.en: We discovered a quiet beach behind the cliffs.
ex.zh: 我们在悬崖后面发现了一片安静的海滩。

ex.en: Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.
ex.zh: 科学家可能通过研究热带森林中的植物，发现治疗疾病的新方法。

col: discover a new species｜发现新物种
tip: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

senses.en: the natural force that pulls things down toward the Earth

ex.en: Apples fall down to the ground because of gravity.
ex.zh: 苹果落到地面上是因为重力的作用。

ex.en: In our science class, we learned that gravity keeps all the planets moving around the sun.
ex.zh: 在科学课上，我们学到重力让所有行星围绕太阳运转。

tip: gravity为不可数名词，表示物理中的“重力；地球引力”。

ex.en: We watched the rocket rise above the clouds.
ex.zh: 我们看着火箭升到云层上方。

ex.en: As housing demand continues to grow, rents may rocket in cities with limited space for new development.
ex.zh: 随着住房需求持续增长，新开发空间有限的城市可能出现租金飞涨。

tip: 作动词常描述价格等猛涨，比increase语气更强。

ex.en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
ex.zh: 作为一名足球迷，我几乎不错过任何一场比赛。

ex.en: Sports fans can strengthen local communities by supporting neighbourhood teams and participating in shared events.
ex.zh: 体育迷可以通过支持社区球队、参与共同活动来增强当地社区的凝聚力。

tip: 表示“……的爱好者”用a fan of。

ex.en: I did some research before choosing my new bicycle.
ex.zh: 挑选新自行车之前，我做了一番调查。

ex.en: Research into renewable energy can help governments develop cleaner and more reliable sources of electricity.
ex.zh: 对可再生能源的研究可以帮助政府开发更清洁、更可靠的电力来源。

tip: 名词通常不可数；说a study，不说a research。

senses.en: a special kind of rice grown by combining two different types to produce more food

ex.en: Farmers can grow much more food with hybrid rice.
ex.zh: 农民们种植杂交水稻可以收获更多的粮食。

ex.en: Chinese scientist Yuan Longping worked hard for years to develop high-yield hybrid rice.
ex.zh: 中国科学家袁隆平辛勤工作多年，培育出了高产的杂交水稻。

col: grow hybrid rice｜种植杂交水稻
develop hybrid rice｜培育杂交水稻
tip: rice是不可数名词，所以hybrid rice后不加s。

ex.en: My creative sister turned old jars into colourful lamps.
ex.zh: 我富有创意的姐姐把旧罐子变成了彩色灯具。

ex.en: Schools should encourage creative thinking by allowing students to explore several solutions to the same problem.
ex.zh: 学校应允许学生探索同一问题的多种解决方案，以鼓励创造性思维。

col: a creative solution｜创新的解决方案
tip: 形容人有创意或方法新颖；名词形式是creativity。

senses.en: always working with a lot of effort and care

ex.en: Lisa is a hard-working student and always finishes her homework early.
ex.zh: 丽莎是一个勤奋的学生，总是很早完成作业。

ex.en: Bees are very hard-working insects that fly from flower to flower all day long.
ex.zh: 蜜蜂是非常勤奋的昆虫，一整天都在花丛间飞来飞去。

tip: 复合形容词，中间有连字符；注意区分work hard（努力工作）。

senses.en: to be widely recognized or called by a particular name or title

ex.en: Shenzhen is known as a clean and modern city in China.
ex.zh: 深圳被认为是中国一座干净又现代化的城市。

ex.en: Yuan Longping is known as the Father of Hybrid Rice all over the world.
ex.zh: 袁隆平在全世界被誉为“杂交水稻之父”。

col: be known as a hero｜被视为英雄
be widely known as｜被广泛认为是
be known as a writer｜作为作家而闻名
tip: be known as后接身份或称号，意为“被称为/被认为是……”。

ex.en: My sister invented a clever tool for picking apples.
ex.zh: 我姐姐发明了一种巧妙的摘苹果工具。

ex.en: Engineers must invent affordable technologies that help rural communities gain access to clean drinking water.
ex.zh: 工程师必须发明价格可负担的技术，帮助农村社区获得清洁饮用水。

tip: invent是创造新事物；discover是发现已有事物。

ex.en: The course gave me practical experience in repairing bikes.
ex.zh: 这门课程让我获得了修理自行车的实践经验。

ex.en: Schools should combine academic learning with practical skills to prepare students for a changing workplace.
ex.zh: 学校应将学术学习与实用技能相结合，帮助学生为不断变化的职场做好准备。

tip: practical可强调亲手实践，也可表示实用、可行。

ex.en: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
ex.zh: 教练向我示范了一种更好的游泳技巧。

ex.en: Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
ex.zh: 教师可以运用多种评估方法，在学生落后之前发现他们的学习困难。

col: a technique for doing something｜做某事的方法
tip: technique重在具体方法；technology指科技。

senses.en: people who are unable to hear sounds

ex.en: Sign language helps the deaf talk easily with other people.
ex.zh: 手语帮助耳聋的人轻松与他人交流。

ex.en: Our school held a charity activity to buy hearing aids and help the deaf.
ex.zh: 我们学校举办了一场慈善活动，购买助听器来帮助耳聋的人。

col: help the deaf｜帮助耳聋的人
school for the deaf｜聋哑学校
care for the deaf｜关爱听障人士
tip: “the+形容词”表示一类人，作主语时谓语动词通常用复数。

ex.en: This village is famous for its delicious apple pies.
ex.zh: 这个村庄以美味的苹果派闻名。

ex.en: Famous landmarks attract international visitors, but tourism revenue should also support the communities surrounding them.
ex.zh: 著名地标吸引着国际游客，但旅游收入也应惠及周边社区。

tip: famous for接出名的原因，famous as接身份。

ex.en: The kitchen bulb failed while I was washing dishes.
ex.zh: 我洗碗时，厨房的灯泡坏了。

ex.en: Replacing traditional bulbs with energy-efficient alternatives can reduce household electricity consumption and lower long-term costs.
ex.zh: 用节能灯泡替换传统灯泡可以减少家庭用电量，并降低长期成本。

tip: 既指灯泡，也指洋葱、水仙等植物的鳞茎。

senses.en: a person who has received a famous international award for great work

ex.en: Tu Youyou is a famous Chinese Nobel Prize winner.
ex.zh: 屠呦呦是一位著名的中国诺贝尔奖得主。

ex.en: Our science teacher told us a story about a Nobel Prize winner in medicine.
ex.zh: 科学老师给我们讲了一位诺贝尔医学奖得主的故事。

col: a Nobel Prize winner｜诺贝尔奖得主
become a Nobel Prize winner｜成为诺贝尔奖得主
meet a Nobel Prize winner｜见一位诺贝尔奖得主
tip: 专有名词Nobel Prize首字母须大写，winner意为“获胜者”。

senses.en: the scientific rule explaining how objects pull toward one another

ex.en: Isaac Newton discovered the law of gravity many years ago.
ex.zh: 艾萨克·牛顿在很多年前发现了万有引力定律。

ex.en: Today in science class, we read a picture book about Newton and the law of gravity.
ex.zh: 今天在科学课上，我们读了一本关于牛顿和万有引力定律的绘本。

col: discover the law of gravity｜发现万有引力定律
explain the law of gravity｜解释万有引力定律
study the law of gravity｜学习万有引力定律
tip: law在这里不是“法律”，而是科学里的“定律、规律”。

ex.en: Her latest invention waters the plants while she is away.
ex.zh: 她最新的发明能在她外出时给植物浇水。

ex.en: The invention of affordable water filters has improved public health in communities with limited access to clean water.
ex.zh: 价格低廉的滤水器的发明改善了难以获得清洁用水的社区的公共卫生状况。

tip: invention创造原本没有的东西；discovery发现已有事物。

ex.en: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
ex.zh: 厨房的水龙头有问题：它一直滴水。

ex.en: Traffic congestion is a growing problem that requires investment in reliable public transport rather than additional roads.
ex.zh: 交通拥堵是日益严重的问题，需要投资建设可靠的公共交通，而不是增建道路。

tip: ……有问题用a problem with；问题的解决办法用to。

ex.en: The front wheel of my bicycle needs replacing.
ex.zh: 我的自行车前轮需要更换。

ex.en: Transport planners should ensure that passengers can wheel their luggage easily through stations and onto trains.
ex.zh: 交通规划者应确保乘客能轻松推着行李穿过车站并登上列车。

tip: at或behind the wheel常表示正在开车。

senses.en: the period of history very long ago

ex.en: People wrote on bamboo slips in ancient times.
ex.zh: 在古代，人们在竹简上写字。

ex.en: In ancient times, Chinese people invented paper, printing, and many other useful things.
ex.zh: 在古代，中国人发明了造纸术、印刷术和许多其他有用的东西。

col: stories from ancient times｜古代的故事
buildings of ancient times｜古代建筑
tip: 表示“在古代”常说in ancient times，注意times要用复数。

senses.en: the skill or method of making many copies of books and pictures

ex.en: Printing helped people make books much faster than before.
ex.zh: 印刷术帮助人们比以前更快地制作书籍。

ex.en: Movable-type printing is one of the Four Great Inventions in Chinese history.
ex.zh: 活字印刷术是中国历史上的四大发明之一。

col: the history of printing｜印刷术的历史
tip: 由动词print加-ing变成名词，指“印刷术；印刷业”。

ex.en: We watched a wildlife programme on television after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后我们在电视上看了一档野生动物节目。

ex.en: Educational television can introduce children to scientific ideas that are difficult to demonstrate in classrooms.
ex.zh: 教育类电视节目可以让儿童接触难以在课堂上演示的科学概念。

tip: watch television不加冠词；指一台电视机用a television。

ex.en: A small robot cleaned the floor while we ate breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们吃早饭时，一台小机器人清扫了地板。

ex.en: Robots can perform repetitive factory tasks, but workers may need additional training to move into new roles.
ex.zh: 机器人可以执行重复性的工厂任务，但工人可能需要额外培训才能转入新岗位。

tip: robot是可数名词；robotics指机器人学。

ex.en: This little torch is useful when the power fails.
ex.zh: 停电时，这个小手电筒很有用。

ex.en: Reliable online resources can be useful for learners who lack access to well-equipped libraries.
ex.zh: 对于无法使用设备完善的图书馆的学习者来说，可靠的网络资源可能很有帮助。

tip: 首音是辅音/j/，所以说a useful tool，不用an。

senses.en: clean water without salt, found in rivers, lakes, and rain

ex.en: All plants and animals need clean fresh water to live.
ex.zh: 所有的动植物都需要干净的淡水才能生存。

ex.en: Only a small part of the water on Earth is fresh water that we can drink.
ex.zh: 地球上只有很小一部分水是我们能饮用的淡水。

tip: fresh本义是“新鲜的”，与water搭配意为“不含盐的淡水”。

senses.en: a machine powered by electricity that blows cool air around a room

ex.en: Please turn on the electric fan on this hot afternoon.
ex.zh: 在这个炎热的下午，请打开电风扇。

ex.en: Before air conditioners became common, almost every family used an electric fan in summer.
ex.zh: 在空调普及之前，夏天几乎家家户户都用电风扇。

col: turn on the electric fan｜开电风扇
an old electric fan｜一台旧电风扇
a small electric fan｜一台小电风扇
tip: electric以元音音素开头，表示“一台电风扇”用an。

senses.en: a kitchen machine used for getting juice out of fruit or vegetables

ex.en: My mom uses a juicer to make fresh orange juice.
ex.zh: 我妈妈用榨汁机做新鲜的橙汁。

ex.en: In our cooking club, we washed some sweet apples and put them into the juicer.
ex.zh: 在烹饪社团里，我们洗了些甜苹果并把它们放进榨汁机。

tip: 由juice去e加r构成，表示“榨取果汁的机器”。

senses.en: a home machine that washes dirty clothes with water and soap

ex.en: Put your dirty sports clothes into the washing machine now.
ex.zh: 现在把你脏的运动服放进洗衣机里吧。

ex.en: Modern washing machines save families a lot of time and hard work every week.
ex.zh: 现代洗衣机每周为家庭节省了大量时间和辛劳。

col: use the washing machine｜用洗衣机
turn on the washing machine｜开洗衣机
a new washing machine｜一台新洗衣机
tip: washing是动名词作定语修饰machine，表示“洗衣服用的机器”。

ex.en: We share the housework so nobody spends Sunday cleaning alone.
ex.zh: 我们分担家务，这样就没人需要独自在周日打扫了。

ex.en: Sharing housework fairly allows family members to balance paid employment with responsibilities at home more effectively.
ex.zh: 公平分担家务可以让家庭成员更有效地平衡有偿工作与家庭责任。

tip: 不可数，不能说a housework；做家务用do。

senses.en: in a pleasant, relaxed way without pain or worry

ex.en: Our cat is sleeping comfortably on the soft warm sofa.
ex.zh: 我们的小猫正舒服地睡在柔软温暖的沙发上。

ex.en: Because of modern inventions, people can travel comfortably across the country by high-speed train.
ex.zh: 因为现代发明，人们可以乘坐高铁舒服地穿越全国。

tip: 由形容词comfortable去e加y变成副词，注意拼写变化。

senses.en: a computer designed to stay on a desk rather than be carried around

ex.en: My dad has a fast desktop in his study room.
ex.zh: 我爸爸在他的书房里有一台很快的台式电脑。

ex.en: In our school computer lab, every student sits in front of a clean desktop.
ex.zh: 在学校微机室里，每个学生都坐在一台干净的台式电脑前。

col: a school desktop｜学校台式电脑
tip: 由desk（书桌）和top（顶部）合成，原指“放在桌上的电脑”。

senses.en: red, yellow, and green lights that tell cars and people when to stop or go

ex.en: Always look at the traffic lights before you cross the street.
ex.zh: 过马路前一定要看红绿灯。

ex.en: At the busy crossing near our school, smart traffic lights help keep all students safe.
ex.zh: 在我们学校附近繁忙的十字路口，智能红绿灯帮助保障所有学生的安全。

col: wait at the traffic lights｜在红绿灯处等
look at the traffic lights｜看红绿灯
obey the traffic lights｜遵守交通信号灯
tip: 一组信号灯有红黄绿三种颜色，所以light通常用复数lights。

senses.en: to find the right answers or ways to deal with difficulties

ex.en: Good friends often help each other solve problems at school.
ex.zh: 好朋友在学校里经常互相帮助解决问题。

ex.en: Engineers use science and creative thinking to solve problems in our daily lives.
ex.zh: 工程师们运用科学和创造性思维来解决我们日常生活中的问题。

col: solve problems together｜一起解决问题
help solve problems｜帮助解决问题
tip: solve意为“解决；解答”，常与problem搭配，不与question搭配。

ex.en: In the story, the prince becomes friends with his enemy.
ex.zh: 故事里，王子和他的敌人成了朋友。

ex.en: Public distrust can become an enemy of effective environmental policy, particularly when governments fail to explain their decisions.
ex.zh: 公众的不信任可能成为有效环境政策的大敌，尤其是在政府未能解释其决策时。

tip: enemy指敌人；比赛对手通常用opponent。

ex.en: My laptop fits neatly into the front of my backpack.
ex.zh: 我的笔记本电脑正好能放进背包前面的隔层。

ex.en: Providing every student with a laptop may improve access to learning resources, but technical support remains essential.
ex.zh: 为每位学生配备笔记本电脑或许能改善学习资源的获取，但技术支持仍然必不可少。

col: laptop charger｜笔记本电脑充电器
tip: laptop是便携电脑；desktop通常指台式电脑。

ex.en: I forgot my password and couldn't open my account.
ex.zh: 我忘了密码，无法登录账户。

ex.en: Using a different password for each account can reduce the risk of personal information being stolen.
ex.zh: 为每个账户设置不同的密码，可以降低个人信息被盗的风险。

col: a strong password｜安全性高的密码
tip: password是密码；passcode也可指数字口令。

ex.en: Click on the picture to see a larger version.
ex.zh: 点击图片即可查看大图。

ex.en: Students should check whether a website is trustworthy before they click on links or share personal information.
ex.zh: 学生在点击链接或分享个人信息前，应检查网站是否可信。

col: click on a link｜点击链接
a mouse click｜一次鼠标点击
a sharp click｜清脆的咔嗒声
tip: 点击链接常用click on；it clicked可指突然想通了。

senses.en: a small hand-held device used to move the arrow on a computer screen

ex.en: Click the left button on the mouse to open the file.
ex.zh: 点击鼠标左键就可以打开这个文件。

ex.en: In computer class, we learned how to use a mouse to draw simple shapes.
ex.zh: 在微机课上，我们学习了如何用鼠标画简单的图形。

tip: 此处指电脑“鼠标”；作鼠标讲时复数常用mouses或mice。

senses.en: to keep things or computer information safely for future use

ex.en: I store all my favorite family photos on this computer.
ex.zh: 我把自己最喜欢的全家福照片都储存在这台电脑里。

ex.en: A small microchip can store a huge amount of information inside a smart phone.
ex.zh: 一块小小的芯片可以在智能手机里储存海量信息。

col: store data safely｜安全储存数据
tip: store作名词是“商店”，作动词则意为“储存；保存”。

ex.en: Please delete those blurry photos from my phone.
ex.zh: 请把我手机里那些模糊的照片删掉。

ex.en: Online services should allow users to delete their personal data when they no longer need an account.
ex.zh: 当用户不再需要账户时，网络服务应允许他们删除个人数据。

tip: 常用delete something from...表示从某处删除。

senses.en: a folder on a computer where deleted files are kept temporarily

ex.en: Check the Recycle Bin if you deleted a file by mistake.
ex.zh: 如果你不小心删了文件，可以去回收站里找找。

ex.en: Before turning off the computer, remember to empty the Recycle Bin to save space.
ex.zh: 关电脑之前，记得清空回收站以节省空间。

col: empty the Recycle Bin｜清空回收站
send to the Recycle Bin｜放入回收站
restore from the Recycle Bin｜从回收站恢复
tip: 电脑桌面上的“回收站”通常首字母大写，写作Recycle Bin。

senses.en: most famous or recognized by the largest number of people

ex.en: The Great Wall is China's best-known building around the world.
ex.zh: 长城是中国在全世界最有名的建筑。

ex.en: He is one of the best-known scientists in history because of his great inventions.
ex.zh: 由于他伟大的发明，他是历史上最有名的科学家之一。

col: one of the best-known｜最著名的……之一
tip: 由well-known的最高级变来，中间加连字符作前置定语。

ex.en: I brushed the crumbs off my keyboard before starting work.
ex.zh: 开始工作前，我把键盘上的碎屑刷掉了。

ex.en: Students with limited mobility may benefit from an adapted keyboard that makes digital learning more accessible.
ex.zh: 行动不便的学生可能受益于经过改装的键盘，从而更方便地参与数字化学习。

col: play the keyboard｜弹电子键盘乐器
tip: 电脑键盘常说a keyboard；演奏键盘乐器用play the keyboard。

senses.en: a very tiny electronic part inside a computer or smart machine

ex.en: There is a tiny microchip inside almost every modern phone.
ex.zh: 几乎每部现代手机里面都有一块微小的芯片。

ex.en: In science class, we saw how a small microchip helps a robot think and move.
ex.zh: 在科学课上，我们看到了小小的芯片如何帮助机器人思考和移动。

col: a tiny microchip｜一块微小的芯片
tip: 前缀micro-表示“微小的”，加上chip（碎片/芯片）就是微芯片。

senses.en: one very tiny crystal or piece of salt

ex.en: Look closely at the plate and see a grain of salt.
ex.zh: 仔细看看盘子，能看到一粒盐。

ex.en: A modern microchip can be even smaller than a grain of salt on the table.
ex.zh: 一块现代芯片甚至可以比桌上的一粒盐还要小。

col: smaller than a grain of salt｜比一粒盐还小
a grain of sand｜一粒沙子
tip: salt是不可数名词，表示“一粒盐”要用量词a grain of。

ex.en: Please email me the photos from our camping trip.
ex.zh: 请把我们露营旅行的照片通过电子邮件发给我。

ex.en: Although email enables rapid communication, excessive messages can distract employees and reduce productivity at work.
ex.zh: 虽然电子邮件可以实现快速沟通，但过多的邮件会分散员工注意力，降低工作效率。

col: send an email｜发送电子邮件
check your email｜查看电子邮件
an email address｜电子邮箱地址
tip: 指一封邮件时可数；指通信方式时不可数，如by email。

senses.en: to look carefully on the internet or in books to find facts

ex.en: I often use the computer to search for information online.
ex.zh: 我经常用电脑在网上搜索信息。

ex.en: Students can go to the school library to search for information for their science report.
ex.zh: 学生们可以去学校图书馆为他们的科学报告搜索信息。

col: search for information online｜在网上搜索信息
search for useful information｜搜索有用信息
learn to search for information｜学会搜索信息
tip: information是不可数名词，不能在词尾加s；search后接for。

senses.en: a mark, letter, or sign used to represent an idea or action in math or computers

ex.en: The plus sign is a useful symbol in math class.
ex.zh: 加号是数学课上一个很有用的符号。

ex.en: Look at the small symbol on the screen and click it to save your picture.
ex.zh: 看看屏幕上的那个小符号，点击它就能保存你的图片。

col: type a symbol｜输入一个符号
tip: 本课指电脑或数学里的“符号”，也可作“象征”讲，是可数名词。

ex.en: We played a music quiz after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们玩了音乐知识问答游戏。

ex.en: A short quiz at the beginning of each lesson can help teachers identify gaps in students' understanding.
ex.zh: 每节课开始时的小测验可以帮助教师发现学生理解上的不足。

tip: 复数为quizzes；过去式为quizzed。

senses.en: to use something again instead of throwing it away

ex.en: We can reuse old glass bottles to hold colorful flowers.
ex.zh: 我们可以再次使用旧玻璃瓶来插五颜六色的花。

ex.en: In our green school project, students reuse paper boxes to make nice pen holders.
ex.zh: 在绿色校园项目中，学生们再次使用旧纸盒制作漂亮的笔筒。

col: reuse old bags｜重复使用旧袋子
reduce and reuse｜减量与再利用
tip: 前缀re-表示“再、又”，加上use（使用）就是“再次使用”。

ex.en: We recycle glass bottles at the centre near our house.
ex.zh: 我们把玻璃瓶送到家附近的回收中心回收。

ex.en: Cities can reduce landfill waste by making it easier for residents to recycle everyday packaging.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过方便居民回收日常包装来减少填埋垃圾。

col: recycle household waste｜回收生活垃圾
tip: recycle指回收加工再利用，reuse侧重直接再次使用。

senses.en: to put something you do not want anymore into the trash

ex.en: Do not throw away old newspapers because we can recycle them.
ex.zh: 不要扔掉旧报纸，因为我们可以回收它们。

ex.en: Before you throw away plastic bottles, think about how to turn them into useful crafts.
ex.zh: 在你扔掉塑料瓶之前，想想怎么把它们变成有用的手工艺品。

col: throw away old things｜扔掉旧东西
tip: throw过去式是threw；代词放中间，如throw it away。

ex.en: This lunch box is made of strong recycled plastic.
ex.zh: 这个午餐盒由结实的再生塑料制成。

ex.en: Reducing single-use plastic packaging could protect marine ecosystems and lower the costs of managing household waste.
ex.zh: 减少一次性塑料包装可以保护海洋生态系统，并降低生活垃圾处理成本。

tip: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。

ex.en: She chose soft cotton cloth for the baby's blanket.
ex.zh: 她选了柔软的棉布来做婴儿毯。

ex.en: Replacing disposable wipes with reusable cloth can reduce household waste and lower long-term cleaning costs.
ex.zh: 用可重复使用的布代替一次性湿巾，可以减少家庭垃圾并降低长期清洁成本。

tip: 布料义不可数；抹布可数，复数cloths；勿混clothes。

senses.en: to stop a light, machine, or water tap from working by pressing a switch

ex.en: Please turn off the lights before you leave the classroom.
ex.zh: 离开教室前请关掉电灯。

ex.en: To save energy at home, we should always turn off the TV when nobody is watching.
ex.zh: 为了在家节约能源，没人看电视时我们应该总是把它关掉。

col: turn off the tap｜关掉水龙头
tip: 反义词组是turn on（打开）；代词it放中间：turn it off。

ex.en: Please turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
ex.zh: 刷牙时请关上水龙头。

ex.en: Universities can tap local expertise to develop practical solutions to environmental problems affecting nearby communities.
ex.zh: 大学可以利用当地的专业知识，为影响周边社区的环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。

col: turn off the tap｜关上水龙头
tap someone on the shoulder｜轻拍某人的肩膀
tip: 水龙头在美式英语中常称faucet。

ex.en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
ex.zh: 这把小椅子完全由实木制成。

ex.en: Using wood from responsibly managed forests can reduce the environmental impact of constructing new homes.
ex.zh: 使用来自负责任管理的森林的木材，可以减少建造新住宅对环境的影响。

col: a piece of wood｜一块木头
walk in the woods｜在树林中散步
tip: 木材义不可数；树林可说a wood或the woods。

senses.en: to pull the plug of an electrical machine out of the wall socket

ex.en: Always unplug the toaster after you finish making warm bread.
ex.zh: 烤完热面包后，一定要拔掉烤面包机的电源。

ex.en: Before going on a long trip, my parents unplug the computer and TV to stay safe.
ex.zh: 去长途旅行前，我父母会拔掉电脑和电视的电源以确保安全。

col: unplug the computer｜拔掉电脑电源
remember to unplug｜记得拔掉电源
tip: 前缀un-表示否定或相反动作，unplug意为“拔掉……的插头”。

ex.en: Air pollution makes the distant hills difficult to see.
ex.zh: 空气污染让远处的山丘难以看清。

ex.en: Reducing pollution requires governments to regulate industrial emissions while encouraging cleaner transport and more sustainable production methods.
ex.zh: 减少污染需要政府监管工业排放，同时鼓励更清洁的交通方式和更可持续的生产方式。

tip: pollution不可数；具体污染物用pollutant。

senses.en: to move past someone or something in the water by swimming

ex.en: Look! Two colorful little fish swim by the green rock.
ex.zh: 看！两条五颜六色的小鱼从绿色的石头旁游过。

ex.en: When we visited the ocean park, we watched a sea turtle swim by the big window.
ex.zh: 去海洋公园参观时，我们看到一只海龟从大玻璃窗旁游过。

col: swim by the boat｜从船边游过
watch fish swim by｜看鱼儿游过
tip: by作副词意为“经过”；swim的过去式是swam。

ex.en: Please swallow your food before you start talking again.
ex.zh: 请先把食物咽下去再说话。

ex.en: Consumers should not simply swallow advertising claims without examining the evidence behind promises of better health.
ex.zh: 消费者不应不加审查就轻信广告中改善健康的承诺，而应考察背后的证据。

tip: swallow your pride指放下自尊，接受不情愿的事。

senses.en: to be left untidily in different places instead of being put away

ex.en: Do not leave your dirty socks to lie around the room.
ex.zh: 不要把你的脏袜子在房间里到处乱放。

ex.en: Plastic bags should not lie around on the beach because they can hurt ocean animals.
ex.zh: 塑料袋不应该在海滩上到处乱放，因为它们会伤害海洋动物。

col: lie around the house｜在屋里到处乱放
toys lie around｜玩具到处乱放
trash lies around｜垃圾到处乱扔
tip: lie作“躺/平放”讲时，现在分词是lying，过去式是lay。

senses.en: to lift something up from the ground or a surface using your hand

ex.en: Please pick up the fallen pencil under your chair.
ex.zh: 请把你椅子下面掉落的铅笔捡起来。

ex.en: During our park cleanup day, students wore gloves to pick up plastic bottles and paper.
ex.zh: 在公园清洁日，学生们戴上手套捡起塑料瓶和废纸。

col: pick up a book｜拿起一本书
tip: 意为“拿起；捡起”，接代词it/them时须放中间，如pick it up。

senses.en: a large turtle with flippers that lives in the ocean

ex.en: A giant sea turtle swims slowly through the blue ocean.
ex.zh: 一只巨大的海龟在蓝色的大海里慢慢地游动。

ex.en: In nature class, we learned how to protect baby sea turtles when they reach the sea.
ex.zh: 在自然课上，我们学习了当小海龟爬向大海时如何保护它们。

col: a baby sea turtle｜一只小海龟
tip: sea turtle指生活在海里的龟，注意与陆龟tortoise区分。

senses.en: to use water carefully without wasting any

ex.en: We can save water by taking shorter showers every day.
ex.zh: 我们可以通过每天缩短淋浴时间来节约用水。

ex.en: Fresh water is precious on Earth, so every student should try to save water at school.
ex.zh: 地球上的淡水很珍贵，所以每个学生在学校都应该尽量节约用水。

col: save water every day｜每天节约用水
ways to save water｜节水方法
help save water｜帮助节约用水
tip: save除了“拯救”，在环保主题中常译为“节约；节省”。

senses.en: to make a room neat and clean by putting things in their right places

ex.en: I always tidy the room on Saturday morning with my sister.
ex.zh: 周六早上我总是和妹妹一起整理房间。

ex.en: After finishing our craft project, everyone helped tidy the room before going home from school.
ex.zh: 做完手工项目后，大家在放学回家前一起帮忙整理房间。

col: tidy the room up｜把房间整理好
help tidy the room｜帮忙整理房间
keep the room tidy｜保持房间整洁
tip: tidy既可作动词“整理”，也可作形容词“整洁的”，变三单为tidies。

ex.en: Could you carry this heavy bag upstairs for me?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这个沉重的袋子拿上楼吗？

ex.en: Reusable bottles allow commuters to carry drinking water without purchasing disposable plastic containers every day.
ex.zh: 可重复使用的水瓶让通勤者能随身带水，无须每天购买一次性塑料容器。

tip: carry强调携带或搬运；bring和take还体现方向。

senses.en: to talk with someone in a friendly and relaxed way

ex.en: I love to chat with my best friend during lunch break.
ex.zh: 我喜欢在午休时间和我最好的朋友闲聊。

ex.en: After dinner, my family sits in the living room to chat with each other happily.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们一家人坐在客厅里开心地互相闲聊。

tip: chat变过去式和现在分词须双写t，如chatted。

senses.en: to pour water onto flowers so they can grow well

ex.en: Remember to water the flowers on the balcony every morning.
ex.zh: 记得每天早上给阳台上的花浇水。

ex.en: In our school garden club, we take turns to water the flowers and pull weeds.
ex.zh: 在学校园艺社团里，我们轮流浇花和拔草。

col: water the flowers daily｜每天浇花
help water the flowers｜帮忙浇花
water the green plants｜给绿植浇水
tip: water作名词是“水”，作动词时意为“给……浇水”。

senses.en: to look after someone or something and keep them safe and healthy

ex.en: My brother and I help take care of our cute puppy.
ex.zh: 我和哥哥一起帮忙照顾我们可爱的小狗。

ex.en: When we visit the farm, the farmer shows us how to take care of baby sheep.
ex.zh: 我们参观农场时，农民伯伯教我们如何照顾小羊。

col: take care of pets｜照顾宠物
take good care of｜好好照顾
take care of yourself｜照顾好自己
tip: 同义词组是look after；表示“好好照顾”可在中间加good。

ex.en: The soup tasted awful, so I made a sandwich.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，所以我做了个三明治。

ex.en: Residents described the awful conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter safety standards.
ex.zh: 居民描述了过度拥挤住房中的恶劣条件，并呼吁制定更严格的安全标准。

tip: feel awful可指身体难受，也可指内疚或心情差。

senses.en: to be spending a lot of time and effort doing something

ex.en: Tom is busy with his science homework right now.
ex.zh: 汤姆现在正忙着做他的科学作业。

ex.en: All the students are busy with their group posters for the school science fair.
ex.zh: 所有学生都在忙着准备学校科学展的小组海报。

col: be busy with homework｜忙着做作业
be busy with housework｜忙着做家务
be busy with a project｜忙于一个项目
tip: be busy with后接名词；若直接接动词，用be busy doing。

senses.en: to stop sleeping and open your eyes

ex.en: I usually wake up at seven o'clock on school days.
ex.zh: 在上学日我通常七点钟醒来。

ex.en: In spring, bears wake up from their long winter sleep and look for food outside.
ex.zh: 在春天，熊会从漫长的冬眠中醒来，到外面寻找食物。

tip: wake的过去式是woke；若表示“叫醒某人”，代词放中间。

ex.en: I was alone in the kitchen when the kettle boiled.
ex.zh: 水壶里的水烧开时，厨房里只有我一个人。

ex.en: Governments cannot solve environmental problems alone, as lasting progress also requires cooperation from businesses and individual citizens.
ex.zh: 政府无法独力解决环境问题，因为持久的进步也需要企业和公民个人的合作。

tip: alone指独自，不一定孤独；lonely强调孤独感。

ex.en: The sun shone through my bedroom window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，阳光透过我卧室的窗户照了进来。

ex.en: Streetlights that shine directly into homes can disturb sleep and reduce residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 直接照进住宅的路灯会干扰睡眠，降低居民的生活质量。

col: shine a light on｜用灯照向
tip: 发光的过去式常用shone；擦亮的过去式用shined。

ex.en: She added frozen peas to the vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 她往蔬菜汤里加了些冷冻豌豆。

ex.en: Growing peas and other vegetables at school can help children understand where their food comes from.
ex.zh: 在学校种植豌豆和其他蔬菜，可以帮助孩子了解食物的来源。

tip: 可数名词；泛指食用的豌豆通常用复数peas。

ex.en: I felt too weak to carry the shopping upstairs.
ex.zh: 我觉得浑身无力，没法把买来的东西提上楼。

ex.en: Policies based on weak evidence may fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
ex.zh: 依据薄弱证据制定的政策可能无法解决失业的根本原因。

tip: weak与week同音；weakness可指弱点，也可指虚弱。

ex.en: Be careful not to break that glass bowl.
ex.zh: 小心别打碎那个玻璃碗。

ex.en: Regular breaks during study sessions may improve concentration and help students retain new information.
ex.zh: 学习期间定时休息可能有助于提高注意力，并帮助学生记住新知识。

tip: 动词变化为break—broke—broken；休息用take a break。

ex.en: My brother is strong enough to lift this sofa.
ex.zh: 我哥哥力气很大，能抬起这张沙发。

ex.en: There is strong evidence that regular physical activity improves both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 有充分证据表明，规律的体育活动能改善心理健康并提高学业表现。

tip: strong at表示擅长；strong通常是形容词。

ex.en: The puppy looked scared when it heard the thunder.
ex.zh: 小狗听到雷声时显得很害怕。

ex.en: Students who are scared of making mistakes may avoid speaking during foreign language lessons.
ex.zh: 害怕犯错的学生可能会在外语课上避免开口。

tip: scared形容感到害怕；scary形容令人害怕。

ex.en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
ex.zh: 发现门外放着鲜花，我很惊讶。

ex.en: Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.
ex.zh: 绿地的可及性对居民自报幸福感的影响如此之大，令研究人员感到惊讶。

col: surprised at the result｜对结果感到惊讶
surprised to hear｜听到后感到意外
tip: surprised形容人的感受；surprising形容事物令人惊讶。

ex.en: The children were excited about their first camping trip.
ex.zh: 孩子们对第一次露营旅行感到兴奋。

ex.en: Students are often more excited about learning when lessons involve practical experiments and opportunities for discovery.
ex.zh: 当课程包含实践实验和探索机会时，学生往往对学习更有热情。

tip: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

ex.en: She looked worried when her cat failed to return.
ex.zh: 猫没有回来时，她显得很担心。

ex.en: Many parents are worried about the effects of excessive screen time on their children's sleep.
ex.zh: 许多家长担心过长的屏幕使用时间会影响孩子的睡眠。

tip: worried形容人担忧；worrying形容事物令人担忧。

senses.en: feeling calm, comfortable, and free from worry

ex.en: Listening to soft music always makes me feel very relaxed.
ex.zh: 听轻柔的音乐总是让我感到非常放松。

ex.en: After walking in the quiet forest park, everyone in our class felt happy and relaxed.
ex.zh: 在安静的森林公园散步后，我们班每个人都感到开心又放松。

tip: relaxed描述“人感到放松”，relaxing则表示“事物令人放松”。

senses.en: to feel that something or someone is important and worth thinking about

ex.en: My parents and teachers care about my health and happiness.
ex.zh: 我的父母和老师都非常关心我的健康和快乐。

ex.en: Many young people today care about protecting wild animals and keeping our oceans clean.
ex.zh: 如今许多年轻人都关心保护野生动物和保持海洋清洁。

tip: care about侧重“心里在意、关心”；care for常指“照顾、喜欢”。
